Name: Strike
Description: Deal 20 damage. Countered by Bastion and Mirror.

Name: Pierce
Description: Deal 20 damage straight past Guards. Countered by Mirror and Negate.

Name: Shatter
Description: Deal 20 damage to the rival's newest field card. A hidden card it hits is destroyed outright. Countered by Negate.

Name: Venom
Description: Deal 10 damage now and 10 more at the start of the rival's next turn. Countered by Cleanse.
Spoken: Venom bites. Ten now and ten more next turn.

Name: Gamble Blow
Description: Call the coin. Right: deal 20 damage. Wrong: you take the 20 yourself.

Name: Bastion
Description: A Guard that soaks 40 damage before any reaches you. Countered by Pierce and Shatter.

Name: Mend
Description: Heal 20 Body. Countered by Seal.

Name: Mirror
Description: Hidden. The next attack card played at you bounces back at its owner. Countered by Glimpse.

Name: Cleanse
Description: Remove Venom and Slow from yourself and unseal all your cards.

Name: Regrow
Description: Field. Heal 10 at the start of each of your turns. Breaks after 20 damage. Countered by Shatter.

Name: Negate
Description: Hidden. Cancels the next card the rival plays, whatever it is. Countered by Glimpse.

Name: Slow
Description: The rival's cards cost 2 more Libido for their next 2 turns. Countered by Cleanse.
Spoken: Slowed. Their cards cost two more.

Name: Seal
Description: The last card the rival played cannot be used for 3 turns. Countered by Cleanse.

Name: Erosion
Description: Field. At the start of each of your turns, one of the rival's cards is sealed for the rest of the duel. Breaks after 20 damage. Countered by Shatter.

Name: Stillframe
Description: Call the coin. Right: you take two moves back to back before the rival acts. Wrong: you lose your next turn. Countered by Negate.

Name: Glimpse
Description: See the rival's planned card and turn their hidden cards face up.

Name: Double or Nothing
Description: Call the coin. Right: your next attack deals double. Wrong: your next attack fizzles.

Name: Thief
Description: Call the coin. Right: steal one of the rival's cards for this duel. Wrong: they steal one of yours.

Name: Echo
Description: Play the last card you played again, for free. Countered by Seal.

Name: Loaded Die
Description: Field. At the start of each of your turns, roll a die: 1 or 2 does nothing, 3 to 5 deals 10, a 6 deals 20. Breaks after 20 damage.

Name: Understudy
Description: Juno's card. A Guard that soaks 60 damage meant for you.
